description: Electrical Power Quality - Voltage Dips is a dataset listed in E-REDES open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution operator, published or maintained by E-REDES (Portugal). This dataset presents the analysis of voltage dips on MV busbars in HV/MV substations, according to the classification table in NP EN 50160. Coverage: Portugal. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Operation and Quality of Service. The portal shows 2025-06-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eredes-open-data-portal.
